title: Engine diet: port pano, stems and RIFE nodes into MpiNodes
description: Three one-Flow packs: Mickmumpitz (5 pano nodes for the 360 Flow; pack pulls ultralytics + opencv), audio-separation (AudioSeparation for stems; pulls moviepy, librosa), Frame-Interpolation (only RIFE VFI out of ~25k lines). Port each, drop the pack. Part of the Engine diet umbrella.
